# Roc Realm Perfumes

> Original designer and Arabian perfumes, perfume oils, oud, body mists, and gift sets from Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria. Delivery across Owerri, Port Harcourt, Onitsha, Anambra, and Enugu.

Roc Realm Perfumes (Roc Realm Nigeria Limited) is a perfume store in Uratta, Owerri. We sell authentic designer and Arabic fragrances, long-lasting perfume oils, and gift sets. Customers can order online or via WhatsApp.
